description: Snowflake database provider driver for JD.Efcpt.Build. Install alongside JD.Efcpt.Build and set EfcptProvider=snowflake to scaffold EF Core models from a Snowflake database during your build. See https://jerrettdavis.github.io/JD.Efcpt.Build/user-guide/provider-support.html for the full dependency chain (JD.Efcpt.Build.Snowflake -> Snowflake.Data -> AWSSDK.Core).
title: JD.Efcpt.Build Snowflake Provider
